parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (lead_hash, name, email, phone, message, source)
  VALUES (encode(sha256(convert_to(lower($1::text) || E'\n' || $4::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'),
          $2::text, $1::text, NULLIF($3::text, ''), $4::text, $5::text)
  ON CONFLICT (lead_hash) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id::int AS lead_id, TRUE AS inserted FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT id::int, FALSE FROM leads
 WHERE lead_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(lower($1::text) || E'\n' || $4::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins);

UPDATE leads
   SET status = $2::text,
       score = NULLIF($3::text, ''),
       intent = $4::text, urgency = $5::text, budget_signal = $6::text,
       summary = $7::text, suggested_next_step = $8::text,
       model = $9::text, prompt_version = $10::text,
       qualified_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id::int AS lead_id;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ (() => { const c = $json; const r = c.result || {}; return [
  c.lead_id, c.route === 'needs_review' ? 'needs_review' : 'qualified', r.score || '',
  r.intent ?? null, r.urgency ?? null, r.budget_signal ?? null, r.summary ?? null, r.suggested_next_step ?? null,
  c.model, c.prompt_version ]; })() }}

VALUES ($1::bigint, $2::text, $3::text, NULLIF($4::text, ''), $5::text, $6::text, $7::text)
ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id::int AS crm_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Collect result').first().json; return [ c.lead_id, c.lead.name, c.lead.email, c.lead.phone, c.route, 'hot_follow_up', c.result.summary ]; })() }}

={{ (() => { const c = $('Collect result').first().json; const first = String(c.lead.name).split(/\s+/)[0].replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]/g, '');
  return [ c.lead_id, c.lead.phone, `Hi ${first}, thanks for reaching out! Book a quick call here: ${$env.BOOKING_LINK_URL}` ]; })() }}
